name: Mobile bottom navigation — approval frames
description: 375px (phone / Android TWA viewport) frames for the host shell's primary mobile navigation, closing the gap recorded in docs/design-system/portal-ux.md §5: the design system's mobile guideline specifies a BottomNav below md (≤768px) and the BottomNav primitive exists in @fuzefront/design-system, but it is NOT wired into the host shell — the shell is drawer-only today, so a phone user has no persistent, thumb-reach navigation. These frames freeze how the bottom nav mounts in the shell (3 primary destinations + More), how it coexists with the existing slide-in drawer (one overlay, two triggers — reusing SidePanel/isSidebarOpen, not a second primitive), and the loading/empty/error/safe-area/touch-target states, before any shell code is written. Shell chrome owned by mobile-frontend-engineer; no new npm package. Approving the flow approves the component plan; frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against the data-frame/data-* hooks.

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker + build inventory + the frozen design decisions (3 tabs + More, drawer reuse, fail-open nav) and open questions for approval.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the build inventory and design decisions are visible on the page, not only in manifest.json. No new npm package is listed — the BottomNav primitive already exists in the design system.

frames.label: (01) Bottom nav mounted
frames.summary: The bottom nav mounted in the 375px shell: Home / Apps / Orgs / More, the active-tab fuse-seam indicator, a tab notification badge, collapsed top bar, content scrolling behind a fixed bar.
frames.acceptanceNotes: The bar is fixed at the viewport bottom (height --bottom-nav-height + --safe-area-bottom) and content padding-bottom clears it. Exactly one tab carries aria-current='page', derived from the router pathname (a /app/<slug> route lights the Apps tab). Each tab is >=--touch-target (44px) tall. The More tab is a button with aria-haspopup/aria-expanded that opens the drawer and never navigates. The badge is an accessible count.

frames.label: (02) "More" → drawer
frames.summary: Coexistence with the drawer: tapping More opens the existing SidePanel over a scrim for the long-tail (Billing, Connectors, Profile, Help, Status). Scrim/✕/Esc/item dismiss; More shows pressed + aria-expanded.
frames.acceptanceNotes: More and the top-bar hamburger both call the shell's single toggleSidebar (Layout.tsx isSidebarOpen) — one drawer, two triggers, no second overlay primitive. Open drawer is role='dialog' aria-modal='true'; the scrim covers content AND bar; backgrounded content is aria-hidden; the drawer honours --safe-area-top/-bottom. The drawer holds everything the four bar slots cannot. Dismiss via data-action='close-drawer' (scrim tap), the ✕, Esc, or any item.

frames.label: (03) States & edges
frames.summary: Loading (bar instant, drawer apps skeleton), empty (no registered apps), error (registry failed — nav fail-open, scoped retry), plus safe-area/notch, >=44px touch targets, reduced-motion, and long-label truncation.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading never blanks the bar: [data-component='bottom-nav'][data-state='loaded'] is present from first paint; only the drawer's Apps section shows aria-busy skeletons. Empty keeps all four tabs and offers browse-apps, not a dead end. Error is fail-open and scoped — [data-error] is confined to the drawer Apps section with a retry; Home/Orgs/More and the Portal section stay usable. Safe-area: [data-safe-area='true'] bar height = calc(--bottom-nav-height + --safe-area-bottom); top bar pads --safe-area-top. Every .bn-item is >=--touch-target (44px). Drawer/scrim motion collapses under prefers-reduced-motion. Long labels ellipsize, never wrap or overflow.
